# The installed go command links its build tools: every tool it starts is
# itself, as 'go tool <name>', and nothing under pkg/tool is run.

[short] skip 'builds and runs a program'

exec $GOROOT/bin/go build -x -o hello$GOEXE hello.go
stderr 'go(\.exe)? tool compile '
stderr 'go(\.exe)? tool link '
! stderr 'pkg[/\\]tool[/\\]'
exec ./hello$GOEXE
stdout 'hello'

exec $GOROOT/bin/go vet hello.go

exec $GOROOT/bin/go tool compile -V=full
stdout '^compile version .* buildID='

exec $GOROOT/bin/go tool -n compile -V=full
stdout 'go(\.exe)? tool compile -V=full$'

exec $GOROOT/bin/go tool link -V=full
stdout '^link version '

-- go.mod --
module hello

go 1.27
-- hello.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("hello") }
